name: Claim Jumper Steakhouse (Buena Park — Across from Knott's) Rotisserie Chicken, Tri-Tip & Giant Baked Idaho Potato
brandOrRestaurant: Claim Jumper Steakhouse & Bar (Beach Blvd, Buena Park · Across from Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Directly across Beach Blvd from Knott's Berry Farm, Claim Jumper slow-roasts tender herb Rotisserie Chicken, Grilled Salmon, and Slow-Roasted Tri-Tip served with a 1-lb Baked Idaho Russet Potato or Mashed Potatoes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roasted Chicken Breast, Salmon, or Tri-Tip (BBQ sauce on the side) with a plain Baked Potato (eat the fluffy inside) and warm sourdough/honey bread.
watchOuts: Portions at Claim Jumper are huge—eat half and pack the rest for your hotel fridge
